summary: First build testing complete. All backend APIs and frontend UI flows working correctly. Backend: 27/27 tests passed. Frontend: All 5 tabs functional with RTL Hebrew, filters, navigation, and AI chat integration working perfectly.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' - Minor React Native web deprecation warning, not breaking

critical_code_review_comments: ✅ Backend seed data working correctly (~8 events, 12 businesses, 6 jobs, 6 news)
✅ Open hours logic with UTC+2 Israel time working
✅ AI integration with Claude Sonnet 4.5 via emergentintegrations working perfectly
✅ Intent routing (events/jobs/businesses/news) accurate for Hebrew queries
✅ All components have testID attributes for testing
✅ Mobile-first design with proper spacing (8pt grid)
✅ All API endpoints use EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from environment
✅ MongoDB ObjectId excluded from responses (_clean function)
✅ Error handling present in frontend API calls
seed_data_creation: Backend seeds data on startup: 8 events, 12 businesses, 6 jobs, 6 news items - all in Hebrew
context_for_next_testing_agent: First build fully functional. Metro bundler takes ~15-20s for cold bundle on first request. All 5 tabs working: / (events with band badges), /businesses (with open_now indicator and search), /jobs (with urgency pills), /news (with source badges), /eilatush (AI chat with rich cards). AI uses Claude Sonnet 4.5 via emergentintegrations and returns event/business/job/news cards based on Hebrew queries. RTL Hebrew working correctly. Dark theme applied. No critical issues found.

events_api.details: GET /api/events returns 8 Hebrew events with computed band field. Filters work: band=now/tonight/later, category=party. Events sorted by starts_at.

businesses_api.details: GET /api/businesses returns 12 Hebrew businesses with computed open_now boolean. Filters work: category=bar, open_now=true, search q=סושי. Rating field present.

jobs_api.details: GET /api/jobs returns 6 jobs sorted by urgency (now first). Filters work: urgency=now, category=hotel. posted_at field present.

news_api.details: GET /api/news returns 6 Hebrew news items sorted newest first. Filter works: source=municipality. Valid sources: municipality/alert/event.

eilatush_chat_api.details: POST /api/eilatush/chat returns {session_id, reply, intent, results[]}. Hebrew queries tested: 'מה קורה הערב' (events), 'עבודה דחופה' (jobs), 'סושי' (businesses), 'חדשות מהעירייה' (news). Intent routing accurate. Session persistence works. Results have correct structure with type and item fields.

home_screen.details: Hero title visible, brand visible, 8 event cards loaded, band filter chips work (עכשיו/הערב/בהמשך), category filter chips work (מסיבות), event cards show time band badges and action buttons (call, WhatsApp)

businesses_tab.details: Screen title visible, search input functional, 12 business cards loaded, open_now filter works, business cards show open/closed indicator (פתוח/סגור), category chips work, deal badges visible, rating stars visible

jobs_tab.details: Screen title visible, 6 job cards loaded, urgency filter works (🔥 עכשיו), job cards show urgency pills, salary pills visible, apply button (WhatsApp) present

news_tab.details: Screen title visible, 6 news cards loaded, source filter works (עירייה), news cards show source badges, images loading correctly

eilatush_tab.details: Screen title visible, welcome message visible, 6 suggestion chips present, clicking suggestion 'מה קורה הערב?' works and returns 5 event cards in chat, manual input 'סושי זול' works and returns 11 business cards in chat, AI responses received within 8s

tab_navigation.details: All 5 tabs work correctly, bottom tab bar visible, Eilatush center button prominent (orange), navigation between tabs smooth

rtl_hebrew.details: All text in Hebrew, RTL layout working correctly, text alignment right-to-left

dark_theme.details: Background color #0C0C12 applied, card colors correct, primary orange color (#FF512F) visible

mobile_design.details: Mobile viewport (375x667) works, touch targets adequate, spacing looks good, cards render properly
